title: Roles
description: Add new roles, edit descriptions, delete roles no longer used. Toggle authorities on the Permissions screen.
nameHint: 2–50 characters. The name cannot change and cannot be reused after deletion
levelHintNone: You cannot create roles (your level is unknown)
nameTaken: Same name as an existing role
levelInvalid: Level is a whole number from 1
levelTooHigh: Level exceeds what you can create — see the range in the hint
levelForbidden: Level must be lower than yours
readOnlyHint: Name and level cannot change after creation
createConfirmDescription: Name and level cannot change after creation. The name cannot be reused after deletion either.
deleteConfirm: Delete role <1>{{name}}</1>? The role name cannot be reused after deletion.
